name: Sarah Chen
message: We're scaling fast and our current checkout is losing us customers. We need a full Shopify Plus migration with custom integrations by end of quarter. Can you send over a proposal and available start dates?
justification: The lead has a clear, substantial budget of $15,000/month, a specific and well-defined technical need (Shopify Plus migration with custom integrations for fashion retail), and an explicit timeline (end of quarter).
follow_up_email: Subject: Shopify Plus Migration for Brightpeak -- Hi Sarah, Thanks for reaching out. We would love to help Brightpeak upgrade to Shopify Plus and solve your checkout drop-off challenges. Given your $15,000/month budget, fashion retail focus, and goal to launch custom integrations by the end of the quarter, our team is well-equipped to deliver a seamless transition. Are you available for a 20-minute discovery call this Thursday to discuss your integration requirements and review our available start dates for the proposal? Best, [Your Name]

name: Mike
message: hey do you guys do websites
justification: The lead has a very low and uncertain budget ('a few hundred') along with an extremely vague message without any project details, scope, or business context.

name: Dr. Amir Hassan
message: We operate 6 clinics and need a HIPAA-compliant patient portal with appointment scheduling, telehealth integration, and EHR sync. Timeline is flexible but we'd like to kick off within the next 6 weeks. Please include case studies from healthcare clients.
justification: Dr. Hassan provided a clear, substantial budget of $40,000 - $60,000 along with a highly specific requirement (a HIPAA-compliant patient portal with appointment scheduling, telehealth integration, and EHR sync for 6 clinic locations) and a defined kickoff timeline within 6 weeks.
follow_up_email:

name: Jessica
message: Hi! I love your website designs, just wondering how much a simple blog redesign would cost. Not in a rush, just exploring options for now.
justification: The lead has a $0 budget and an exploratory, non-urgent request for a personal blog redesign, indicating low intent and zero financial commitment.

name: Robert Kim
message: We need a custom fleet-tracking dashboard integrated with our existing ERP (SAP). We've evaluated three vendors already and are ready to move forward with the right partner. Looking to sign a contract within 2 weeks.
justification: The lead has a clear and substantial budget ($25,000 initial plus an ongoing retainer), a highly specific technical need (custom fleet-tracking dashboard integrated with SAP ERP), and an urgent timeline (looking to sign within 2 weeks).
